en: Dependent on a wholesome state that is both a root and associated with a root, there arises an unwholesome state that is neither a root nor dissociated from a root, by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a wholesome state that is both a root and associated with a root, there arises an indeterminate state that is neither a root nor dissociated from a root, by way of root-condition. Wholesome...

Dependent on a state that is both a root and associated with a root, there arise states that are neither unwholesome nor roots and are dissociated from roots, as well as states that are neither indeterminate nor roots and are dissociated from roots, by way of the root condition... three.
(Three [answers] for the unwholesome should be made; three [answers] for the indeterminate should be made.)
In the case of cause, nine … pe … in the case of result, three … pe … in the case of non-disappearance, nine.

Dependent on a wholesome state that is both associated with a cause and not itself a cause, there arises an unwholesome state that is both dissociated from a cause and not itself a cause, by way of the cause-condition.
Dependent on a wholesome state that is both associated with a cause and not itself a cause … pe … [and so forth].

Dependent on a root phenomenon that is neither indeterminate nor dissociated from roots and is not a root itself, there arises, by way of root-condition, a phenomenon that is neither unwholesome nor dissociated from roots and is not a root itself, and which is also neither indeterminate nor dissociated from roots and is not a root itself.

Dependent on a wholesome phenomenon that is associated with roots but is not a root itself, there arise, by way of root-condition, phenomena that are neither unwholesome nor dissociated from roots and are not roots themselves, and which are also neither indeterminate nor dissociated from roots and are not roots themselves. ... [Three.]

Dependent on an unwholesome state that is both associated with a root and not itself a root … three. Indeterminate … three. Under the root condition there are nine … pe … under the resultant condition there are three … pe … under the non-disappearance condition there are nine.
